$comment: Single source for the registry directory. `registries` feeds both /r/registries.json (tooling/build-registry.ts rewrites the @marko-ui url from REGISTRY_BASE_URL at build time) and the /docs/directory page. Every entry must satisfy the marko-ui compatibility contract: target 'marko', url containing '{name}' (packages/marko-ui/src/registry/schema.ts registriesSchema). `wanted` lists libraries we want ported INTO the official repo — the /port-to-marko skill checks this list to route contributors.

registries.name: @marko-ui
registries.description: The official marko-ui registry. shadcn/ui ported to Marko 6, powered by Zag.js state machines — 8 visual styles, one authored source.
